cases.prompt: Write a spec for a command-line tool that converts a folder of Markdown files into one PDF. There is no SPEC.md in the repo yet.
expectations: Asks clarifying questions about objective and users, core features and acceptance criteria, stack and constraints, and boundaries, or states assumptions for them.
The spec, if drafted, covers objective, commands, project structure, code style, testing strategy and boundaries.
Says the spec goes in SPEC.md at the project root and asks the user to confirm before going further.

cases.prompt: Add SAML single sign-on to the app described in SPEC.md. Write the spec for it.

files.SPEC.md:
# Team Notes SPEC

Status: implemented

## Objective
Shared notes for small teams. Email and password sign-in.

## Commands
npm run dev, npm test, npm run build

## Boundaries
- Always: hash passwords with argon2.
- Ask first: new third-party services.
- Never: store plaintext secrets.

expectations: Writes a delta spec in a separate file (for example SPEC-saml-sso.md) covering only the change, and does not overwrite SPEC.md.
Raises the boundary in SPEC.md that a new third-party service needs asking first, since an identity provider is one.
Asks the user to confirm before going further.
